speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long you have had this wound on your right lower leg and if you have a history of diabetes or vascular disease?

speaker: Patient
text: I’ve had this wound on my right lower leg for about six months now. I don’t have diabetes, but I did have a deep vein thrombosis in that same leg five years ago. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of DVT, this is likely venous stasis. Do you experience swelling in that leg, and does the wound have a shallow, irregular shape with yellow slough?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, my legs have been chronically swollen for over ten years. The wound does look shallow and irregular with some yellowish material in it.

speaker: Doctor
text: Your symptoms and history strongly point to a venous stasis ulcer. DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer
